home.title: Unfold a spec into screens, then fold it back into a better spec
home.lede: Drop in a rough product spec. AI proposes three genuinely different design directions and builds a clickable, multi-screen prototype. Every change you make is logged and folded back into an updated spec at the end.
home.privacy: There is no server. Your API key and specs stay in this browser, and requests go straight from your browser to the AI provider.
home.firstVisit: First time here? Start with the finished demo — no API key needed.
home.empty: No projects yet. Start from one of the sample specs on the right.
home.samplesLede: Each one follows every writing tip — a model of a good spec.
home.importFail: That isn't a Specfold project file
home.confirmDelete: Delete “{{name}}” from this browser? This can't be undone.

settings.title: Connect an AI
settings.lede: Paste an API key for the AI service you use. Quick steps use a fast model and design steps use a strong one, to keep costs down.
settings.ollama: Ollama must allow browser requests. Set this environment variable before starting it:
settings.advancedNote: Enter model names exactly as your provider's docs list them. Change the URL if you use a proxy or company gateway.
settings.weakWarn: This model may produce weak designs. Prefer the style presets when choosing a direction.
settings.session: This session only (cleared when the tab closes)
settings.deviceWarn: Anyone using this browser can use the key. Don't choose this on a shared computer.
settings.privacy: Your key is stored only in this browser and is never sent to our servers. Requests go directly from your browser to the AI provider.
settings.needKey: Set up an AI key first

input.title: Write the spec
input.lede: Write freely or upload a file. The checklist on the right flags what's missing as you type.
input.placeholder:
# Service name
One-liner: …

Press “Insert template” for a fill-in-the-blanks outline.
input.drop: Drag .md · .txt · .docx · .pdf · sketch images here, or click to choose
input.missingN: {{n}} essential items are empty. You can still continue, but the result may turn out generic.
input.vagueTitle: Some words steer AI toward generic design

tips.title: Writing tips
tips.lede: The more specific each item is, the less generic the AI's output.
tips.better: Items that make it much better
tips.cliche: “Clean”, “modern”, “sleek” and “minimal” steer AI to the most generic design. Try: clean → generous whitespace / hairline rules / newspaper-ordered.

must.name: One-liner
must.ex: Reserve leftover bakery bread before closing

must.name: Who, and when
must.why: Sets density, type size and tone

must.name: What goes on each screen
must.why: Otherwise AI fills it with anything

must.name: Feelings to avoid
must.why: The strongest guard against generic output

nice.name: Reference products + why
nice.why: Saying why makes mood extraction accurate

nice.name: Real copy & data
nice.why: Designs use real content instead of filler

review.title: The structured spec
review.lede: This is what the design is built from. Fix anything wrong right here, and drag rows to reorder screens.
review.dragHint: Drag rows to reorder. Toggle the chips to set where each screen links.
review.inferredHint: Not in your spec, but the flow needs it, so AI added it

direction.title: Pick a design direction
direction.lede: The colors, fonts and spacing chosen here (design tokens) are shared by every screen. You can still tweak them later in the Adjust panel.
direction.aiHint: They differ on at least three of: theme, type personality, density, layout. Fonts and colors you used recently are avoided.
direction.refHint: Describe a site or upload screenshots; only the mood is extracted into tokens. Logos, copy and exact layouts are never copied.
direction.refPh: e.g. I like this site's big photos and thin serif (URL or description)

empty.ai: No proposals yet — press the button above.

direction.mixLede: Keep the picked direction, but borrow colors or fonts from another.
direction.tokenIssues: {{n}} token issue(s): {{detail}}. Fix them from the Studio's quality check.

studio.autoFixFailed: {{name}}: the automatic quality fix ({{rules}}) did not apply. Retry from the Quality badge.
studio.chatHint: Describe what to change. In Select mode, click an element to change only that. Add features here too.
studio.chatPh: e.g. Add a favorites feature / make the button bigger
studio.fallback: The partial edit didn't fit — fetching the whole screen instead…

adj.note: Only tokens change, so every screen updates at once.
adj.pickFirst: Switch the preview to Select mode and click an element.

export.title: Fold it back into a spec
export.lede: Apply what changed during design to the original spec. Changed lines are marked in blue pencil on the right.
export.htmlHint: Every screen in one clickable file. Needs an internet connection when opened (Tailwind, Google Fonts).
export.changesLede: Only checked items go into the spec.
export.localNote: Without AI, the spec is assembled into a fixed outline (overview, screens, features, flow, design system, history) instead of your original sentences.
export.empty: Choose how to apply changes on the left.
